parameters.name: Description
parameters.description:
The description of the reserved instance. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.

Default value: empty.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ReservedInstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the reserved instance.

parameters.name: ReservedInstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the reserved instance. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length. It must start with a letter or a Chinese character and cannot start with `http://` or `https://`. It can contain digits, colons (:), underscores (_), or hyphens (-).
